tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen background — warm paper. Every screen sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list groups, text fields. Raised one step above `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: segmented-control track, search field, disabled fills, grouped section backgrounds.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (unchecked checkbox, text field). ≥3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `basil-soft`, `paprika-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, metadata, helper text. ≥4.5:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `basil-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholders only. Does NOT meet 4.5:1 — never for information the user needs.

tokens.name: basil
tokens.usage: Brand colour. Primary buttons, selected states, active tab, success, 'on target'. As text: ≥5.8:1 on `surface`/`surface-raised`.

tokens.name: on-basil
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `basil` fill. Dark in the dark theme because basil lightens there.

tokens.name: basil-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for selected chips, selected option cards, 'Optimized version found' panels.

tokens.name: basil-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `basil-soft` (7.6:1 light, 8.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: paprika
tokens.usage: Accent — appetite and change. Highlights what FitMeal changed (ingredient diffs), import CTA, cover. Use sparingly; never for errors.

tokens.name: on-paprika
tokens.usage: Text on a `paprika` fill (5.1:1 light, 8.1:1 dark). Never white.

tokens.name: paprika-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind changed ingredients and 'Why did FitMeal change this?' rows.

tokens.name: paprika-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `paprika-soft` and on `surface-raised` for change labels ('150 g → 200 g').

tokens.name: macro-protein
tokens.usage: Protein in rings, bars and dots. Always paired with the letter P or the word Protein.

tokens.name: macro-carbs
tokens.usage: Carbohydrates in rings, bars and dots. Always paired with C / Carbs. Lighter than protein in both themes.

tokens.name: macro-fat
tokens.usage: Fat in rings, bars and dots. Always paired with F / Fat. Blue so it never relies on a red–green split.

tokens.name: macro-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of macro rings and bars.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: ALLERGY severity, destructive actions, errors, over-limit warnings. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind allergy badges and error banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: INTOLERANCE severity, low-confidence import items, 'over target' hints. Text on `surface-raised` and `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind low-confidence import prompts and intolerance badges.

tokens.name: premium
tokens.usage: Premium tier marks and 'Best optimization' label. Text on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: premium-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind Premium plan card and Premium-only previews.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard / switch-control focus ring: solid 2px outside a 2px `surface` gap. ≥5.8:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind bottom sheets and modals.

families.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", "SF Pro Rounded", ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Onboarding question headlines and the paywall hero. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Large-title screen headers: Today, Plan, Shopping.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Recipe name on the recipe screen, sheet titles.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Meal names on cards, plan-tier names.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: The day's kcal inside the macro ring, before/after kcal on the paywall. Tabular figures.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Macro grams, prices, stat tiles. Tabular figures.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: List row titles, ingredient names, button labels (lg).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text: recipe steps, explanations.
styles.sample: Sear the chicken for 4 minutes a side.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Macro lines, meal metadata, chip labels.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Helper text, disclaimers, legal lines on the paywall.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Section labels and slot names in uppercase: BREAKFAST, PROTEIN.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Tab-bar labels, ring legends, badge text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges, macro dot gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between stacked metadata lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and list rows (vertical), gap between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, button horizontal padding, list row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on iPhone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a large title, onboarding question to options.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on onboarding and paywall.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom safe padding above the sticky CTA.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, macro bar ends, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text fields, segmented-control segments, ingredient rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, swap options, list groups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Meal cards, recipe cards, plan cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners), paywall hero panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, tab-bar indicator, day pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on `surface`. Pair with a `line` border; shadows stay quiet.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the sticky CTA bar.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target for every control (Apple HIG).

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size in rows and buttons.

tokens.name: size-ring
tokens.usage: Daily macro ring on Today.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Tab bar height above the home indicator.
